correctness.rationale: PASS: For every \(p,n,s,t\), subgroup orthogonality gives exact entries \(p^{-s}\mathbf1_{p^{n-s}\mid a-b}-p^{-s-1}\mathbf1_{p^{n-s-1}\mid a-b}\). Three exhaustive cases give residue-class blocks with spectra \(I_p-J_p/p\), \(I_{p-1}-J_{p-1}/p\), and a rank-one all-ones matrix, proving multiplicities and equality cases. The exceptional boundary \(p=2\), \(s+t=n-1\) has no unit eigenvalues. Exact rational and direct DFT checks cover 137 parameter cases; finite tests are corroborative only.
